'''Ryan Hase Hase's Hunt Down Deck''' is a [[Dark]] deck by [[Ryan Hase]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ds40.htm Hase's Hunt Down Deck], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010228020536/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ds40.htm Internet Archive]</ref>
